scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @neighborhood/contracts" "npm run dev -w @neighborhood/api" "npm run dev -w @neighborhood/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @neighborhood/contracts && npm run build -w @neighborhood/api && npm run build -w @neighborhood/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @neighborhood/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
